::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 1st [1869]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection, CO171
:::

Dear [Mrs Mercier](people/person_990.qmd)
As [Madame Melon](people/person_2031.qmd) says SHE has not written to you I enclose her note that you may see how the matter stands. I hope she will have a satisfactory answer about the Grand Bienfacteur

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
